meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将已有小说快速导入标准写作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有写好的小说想继续完善或纳入写作工具链
copy.tagline_en: Import existing novels into a structured writing workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a written novel you want to refine or integrate into a writing toolchain

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把已有的小说（半成品或完本）解析成标准项目结构，包含设定、大纲、正文和追踪等文件。它会自动识别篇幅（长篇/短篇），调用对应的拆解管道，产出可直接续写的写作工程。
howto.when: 当你说“导入小说”、“反向解析”等命令，或要求把已有的小说项目化时触发。

say.text: 请导入这本小说，文件路径是 /路径/小说.txt
say.note: Claude 会开始解析并生成项目结构。

say.text: 把我的书导进来，我想续写
say.note: Claude 会先确认是完整工程还是仅拆文库。

say.text: 反向解析这篇短篇小说
say.note: 调用短篇拆解管道，生成对应结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can parse your existing novel (draft or complete) into a standard project structure with settings, outline, content, and tracking files. It automatically detects length (long/short), calls the corresponding analysis pipeline, and produces a writable engineering output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say commands like "import novel", "reverse parse", or ask to turn an existing book into a project.

say_en.text: Please import this novel, file path is /path/novel.txt
say_en.note: Claude will start parsing and generate project structure.

say_en.text: Import my book, I want to continue writing
say_en.note: Claude will first confirm whether you want full engineering or just analysis.
Calls the short story pipeline to generate corresponding structure.
